name: Shoujo no Boukoku
source:
"Where do you think people go when they die?"

A "Heisei Menhera Literature" visual novel in which you chat with your friend, Momoko, via email at 2am. A little bit of sci-fi, a little bit depressing. 

There are no complicated branches. You can see all the endings by looking at the choices in order.
